summary: A fresh agents roster read no longer waits for the paced refresher when no claim since the newest publication can change a card

replay.detail: No claim replay or recovery behavior changes.

schema.detail: No tables, indexes, triggers, schema-version changes or data rewrites. The check reads the existing claims store_index range the incremental roster fold already reads.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules or digest changes; no coordinated member upgrade required.

compatibility.detail: Response shape, snapshot cut, pagination and the 2 s fresh-read bound are unchanged. A fresh read whose roster inputs changed still waits for a roster at or after its cut; an unchanged roster is served under its own cut.

downtime.detail: No startup work or expected interruption; refresher pacing is unchanged.

manual.detail: No operator actions or configuration changes required.

recovery.detail: No persistent state changes or new swap-back restrictions.
